description: This file defines the StartsWithBinary class in the Twig templating engine, specifically for evaluating whether one string starts with another within Twig expressions.

classes.name: StartsWithBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary expression in Twig that checks if a string starts with another string.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate whether the left string starts with the right string using str_starts_with.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Overrides operator method to provide custom operator string, here effectively empty.
